mentions.name: Follow-along teacher for YouTube tutorials
mentions.description: A follow-along teacher that turns YouTube tutorials into interactive tours: it processes a video link, extracts the action items from the video, and creates a tour so users can interact with each step as they watch the tutorial.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I created a follow along teacher to help you follow youtube tutorials interactively.
It goes through the video link, extracts all the action items and creates a tour for you so that you can interact as you are watching the video.
